# SologoAI

> > Free AI-powered logo generator with commercial rights, creating professional brand assets from text, images, sketches, and design specifications.

SologoAI is a comprehensive AI logo design platform serving 100k+ startups with multimodal generation capabilities (text-to-logo, image-to-logo, sketch-to-logo) and complete brand identity tools. The platform offers free creation with commercial licensing options and supports multiple export formats including SVG vector graphics and PNG files.

## Key Topics

- AI Logo Generator
- Text-to-Logo
- Sketch-to-Logo
- Image-to-Logo
- SVG Vector Export
- AI Brand Kit
- Logo Animation
- AI Mockup Generator
- Logo Vectorizer
- Brand Identity
- Commercial Licensing
- Logo Background Removal
- Monogram Logos
- Wordmark Design
- Logo Customization

## Core Logo Generation Tools

- [Free AI Logo Generator](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-generator): Main AI logo generator: create from text, photo, or drawing with animation
- [Image to Logo Generator](https://www.sologo.ai/image-to-logo-ai-generator): Convert photos and sketches to AI-powered logos with customization
- [Sketch to Logo Maker](https://www.sologo.ai/sketch-to-logo-ai-generator): Transform hand-drawn sketches into vector logos with SVG/PNG export
- [Name to Logo Maker](https://www.sologo.ai/name-to-logo-maker): Text-based logo generator from brand names with multilingual support

## Brand Identity & Design Suite

- [AI Brand Kit Generator](https://www.sologo.ai/brand-kit-generator): Generate complete brand identity with logo, colors, fonts, and templates
- [AI Brand Image Generator](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-brand-image): Generate multiple brand image sets and mockups with style reference
- [AI Mockup Generator](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-mockup): Showcase logos on t-shirts, packaging, cards, and products instantly
- [Logo Animation Generator](https://www.sologo.ai/logo-animation-generator): Create animated logos with templates and motion design customization

## Specialized Logo Types

- [Company Logo Maker](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-generator/company-logo-maker): Professional company logo maker for startups and enterprises
- [Wordmark Logo Maker](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-generator/wordmark-maker): Design wordmark logos with custom typography and layout options
- [Monogram Logo Maker](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-generator/monogram-logo-maker): Free AI monogram logo generator with customization options
- [Emblem Creator](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-generator/emblem-maker): Generate emblem logos for gaming, business, and brand identity
- [Football Logo Creator](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-generator/football-logo-maker): AI football logo generator for teams, leagues, and sports events

## Logo Processing & Export Tools

- [AI Logo Vectorizer](https://www.sologo.ai/ai-logo-vectorizer): Convert JPG/PNG images to clean SVG vector graphics
- [Logo Background Remover](https://www.sologo.ai/logo-remove-bg): Remove backgrounds from logos for transparent PNG/SVG export
